name: Peacock
notes: Researched from public peacocktv.com/help articles only (no sign-in). Peacock renews monthly or annually to a credit or debit card, PayPal or an in-app purchase; there is no separate AutoPay, paper bill, guest pay or payment plan, and no refunds for prior payments. The public sign-in page shows Email and Password on one form, with I don't know my password and Sign in without password links; the documented password tip (at least 10 characters with letters and numbers) is applied. Account tabs include Plans & Payment, Subscriptions and Settings. Third-party billed subscribers cancel with that party. There are no installment plans; payment_arrangement stays at the family default only because the streaming template always renders an installments form, and the setup-payment-plan task is suppressed. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

passwordRule.message: Passwords must be at least 10 characters long and contain both letters and numbers.

guest_pay.note: The membership is charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Peacock renews automatically each month or year and charges the payment method on file; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring charges stop only when you cancel the subscription.

paperless.note: No paper bills are mailed; charges are shown on the account page and receipts are emailed.

payment_arrangement.note: Peacock charges the subscription price each billing period and does not offer installment plans.

cancel_service.note: Select Cancel All Subscriptions on your account; this ends the base plan and add-ons at the end of the term. Third-party billed subscribers cancel with that party.

help.title: How much does Peacock cost?
paragraphs: Peacock Premium is $12.99 a month or $129.99 a year plus tax. Peacock Premium Plus, with almost no ads, is $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year plus tax; ads still appear in channels, live sports and events and a few titles.
The Peacock Select tier is $8.99 a month or $89.99 a year.

help.title: Change your Peacock plan
paragraphs: If Peacock bills you directly, go to your Account on the web and click Change Plan to switch between Premium and Premium Plus; a toggle chooses monthly or annual billing. If a third party bills you, your Account screen says so and you change the plan through them.

help.title: How to cancel your Peacock plan
paragraphs: Canceling ends your base plan (Select, Premium or Premium Plus) and any add-ons; the plan does not renew at the end of its term. You see a confirmation on screen and get an email, which can take a few hours. Peacock does not refund or credit earlier payments unless the law requires it.

To drop only an add-on, choose it on the Subscriptions tab and select Remove Add-On. If you subscribed through Apple, Google, Roku, Amazon or a TV provider, cancel with them; the Payment Method section shows who bills you.

help.title: Payment methods and history
paragraphs: Peacock accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and in-app purchases on supported devices.
Direct-billed subscribers can review upcoming charges and select View Payment History on the Plans & Payment tab of the Account page.

help.title: Reset your Peacock password
steps: Click Sign in, then I don't know my password (the help article calls it Forgot Password?).
Enter the email you signed up with and click Continue.
Open the reset email and follow the link.
paragraphs: The reset link works once and expires after 3 hours. Passwords must be at least 10 characters with both letters and numbers.

extra.intent: Find the annual price of Peacock Premium Plus. Do not change your plan.

solution.text: Peacock Premium Plus costs $199.99 a year plus tax.

extra.intent: Find out how long a Peacock password reset link stays valid. Do not reset your password.

solution.text: The reset link is valid for 3 hours and can be used once.
